concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of *validated real* datasets (ARFF/CSV) from external sources. The task list replaces this with a synthetic DGP generation step (T013, T040) and never references any real data source, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

SC-004 specifies that success is measured by the *variation in the interaction p‑value* across the defined threshold sweeps. The implemented metric in Phase 4 (T030) is an *instability ratio* based on CI crossing zero, which does not directly capture p‑value variation, thus the success criterion is not satisfied.
